question.prompt: In \(\triangle ABC\), \(DE\parallel BC\), \(AD=2\), \(DB=3\), and \(AE=4\). Find \(EC\). (\(D\) lies on \(AB\), and \(E\) lies on \(AC\).)

solutions.explanation: Parallel lines divide line segments proportionally, so \(AD/DB=AE/EC\), or \(2/3=4/EC\). Therefore, \(EC=6\).
solutions.title: Use proportional segments
